version: v3 — 质量底线 + 必要性过滤器
derived_from: retro SKILL.md 周期性复盘核心职责
design_philosophy: Retrospective 的核心资产是'逆向思维技术'（假设失败→向前找问题）与'经验沉淀闭环'（发布后学习→指导下次需求）。提纯策略：保留 Tiger/Paper Tigers/Elephants 三分法原文，压缩上下文查询细节、gbrain schema 字段说明等辅助信息

non_negotiable: Pre-mortem 核心定义原文：A pre-mortem is a structured risk-identification exercise that forces teams to think critically about what could go wrong before launch, when there's still time to act
Tiger 分类三原则：Tigers(真实风险)/Paper Tigers(过度担忧)/Elephants(未说出口忧虑) 必须完整且各有明确判定标准
Urgency classification: Launch-Blocking/Fast-Follow/Track 三类必现且带定义
Action plan template for Launch-Blocking Tigers: Risk/Mitigation/Owner/Due Date 四字段不可缺
Retro trigger gate: weekly retro/what did we ship/engineering retrospective 触发词存在
Gbrain context queries 核心查询项至少保留 timeline.jsonl 和 learnings.jsonl 引用
compressible: Preamble gstack-skill-start 脚本完整命令（仅保留调用示意）
AskUserQuestion 格式详细模板（简化为结构化要点）
Telemetry logging 具体字段说明（保留命令示例即可）
Cross-project learnings consent question prose（保留核心逻辑即可）
Completion Status Protocol 四种状态定义详细说明（保留表格即可）
Operational Self-Improvement log 脚本的具体 jq 语法（保留命令名称即可）

prompt_template.input: 项目 URL/功能描述 + 时间周期（周/迭代/月度）
instructions: 1. Pre-mortem Analysis (if preparing for launch): Imagine product launches/fails in X days → categorize as Tigers/Paper Tigers/Elephants
2. Urgency Classification: Label each Tiger as Launch-Blocking/Fast-Follow/Track with concrete thresholds
3. Action Plans: For each Launch-Blocking Tiger, create Risk/Mitigation/Owner/Due Date quadruple
4. Retro Review (if completing period): Analyze commit history, work patterns, code quality metrics
5. Team-Aware Breakdown: Per-person contributions with praise and growth areas
6. Trend Tracking: Cross-reference prior retros, recent timeline events, recent learnings
7. Output Format: Markdown with emoji section tags, tiger/electphant labels, urgency badges

line_patterns.premortem_core_definition: pre-mortem.*structured risk-identification|forces teams to think critically about what could go wrong

mechanical_audit_spec.verdict: 全部 6 项 pattern 通过 = 提纯成功；任何一项缺失 = 回到 baseline 诊断

success_criteria: 输出文档行数 ≤ baseline 的 60%
Pre-mortem 核心定义出现 ≥1 次
Tiger/Paper Tigers/Elephants 三分法完整（每项有定义）
Launch-Blocking/Fast-Follow/Track 三类急迫性标签全部存在
Action Plan 四字段模板（Risk/Mitigation/Owner/Due Date）完整
Retro 触发门控六类关键词 ≥1 次
Gbrain context queries 至少提及 timeline.jsonl + learnings.jsonl 两个文件
无凑数内容（禁止 '至少 N 个元素' 式计数规则）
